title: Rotating Documentary Natural homepage artwork
authorization_quote: Or let's make a few that we can keep changing instead of a static  image
implementation: One shared HomeArt component for coastal and full homepage.
Four scenes; first is A Quiet Crossing; automatic change every nine seconds.
Previous, next and pause/play buttons; manual selection pauses automatic changes.
Pause on mouse hover, focus, hidden tab or when artwork is outside the viewport.
Reduced-motion preference starts paused and disables the fade.
Decode before switching; failed images preserve the current image.
Static first scene without JavaScript; controls appear only after controller initialization.
AI-generated imagined-scene caption and image alt text retained.
Responsive WebP variants; original PNGs and generation prompts preserved.

checks.controller_tests: 6 passed; autoplay timing, reduced motion, interaction/visibility pauses, load failure, in-flight cancellation, live motion preference.
checks.artifact_check: Four hero sources and all responsive variants retained in coastal output, one high-priority image.
checks.browser_visual_review: Blocked by browser admin-enforced security-policy verification. No bypass attempted; desktop/mobile rendering remains unverified.

limitations: Imagined AI-generated scenes, not documentary photographs or authenticated boat-construction references.
No public deployment or completed browser visual review claimed.
